'''Skatheris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Skatheris began studying the creatures known as [[K'lor'slug/Legends|k'lor'slugs]] on their native [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Noe'ha'on/Legends|Noe'ha'on]], in hopes of eliminating the k'lor'slug infestation on the planet [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. With the help of other bioanalysts, Skatheris developed a prototype anti-k'lorl'slug serum.<ref name="K'lor'slug" />

==Behind the scenes==
Skatheris was first mentioned in the Bioanalysis crew skill mission "The K'lor'slug Expedition" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. With Game Update 4.1, the mission was made available to both factions, and Skatheris was referred to as faction-ambiguous "Professor Skatheris."
